question.en: How did Roy stop the thieves?
question.zh: 罗伊是怎样拦住小偷的？

sentences.en: How did Roy stop the thieves?
sentences.zh: 罗伊是怎样拦住小偷的？

sentences.en: Roy Trenton used to drive a taxi.
sentences.zh: 罗伊·特雷顿过去开出租车。

sentences.en: A short while ago, however, he became a bus driver and he has not regretted it.
sentences.zh: 但不久前他成了一名公共汽车司机，对此他并不后悔。

sentences.en: He is finding his new work far more exciting.
sentences.zh: 他觉得新工作有趣得多。

chunks.x: his new work far more exciting
his new work far more exciting

sentences.en: When he was driving along Catford Street recently, he saw two thieves rush out of a shop and run towards a waiting car.
sentences.zh: 最近他正沿卡特福德街开车时，看见两个小偷从一家商店冲出来，朝一辆等候的汽车跑去。

sentences.en: One of them was carrying a bag full of money.
sentences.zh: 其中一个提着满满一袋钱。

sentences.en: Roy acted quickly and drove the bus straight at the thieves.
sentences.zh: 罗伊迅速行动，把车直冲小偷开去。

sentences.en: The one with the money got such a fright that he dropped the bag.
sentences.zh: 拿钱的那个吓得把袋子扔了。

sentences.en: As the thieves were trying to get away in their car, Roy drove his bus into the back of it.
sentences.zh: 小偷正要开车逃走时，罗伊把公共汽车撞上了它的尾部。

sentences.en: While the battered car was moving away, Roy stopped his bus and telephoned the police.
sentences.zh: 那辆被撞坏的车开走时，罗伊停下公共汽车报了警。

chunks.x: While the battered car was moving away

sentences.en: The thieves'car was badly damaged and easy to recognize.
sentences.zh: 小偷的车损坏严重，很容易辨认。

sentences.en: Shortly afterwards, the police stopped the car and both men were arrested.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，警察截住了那辆车，两个人都被抓住了。
